why: Don't attack. Kird Ape (1/1) into Grizzly Bears (2/2) trades unfavorably—both die, I lose board presence. Better to hold back, let opponent's 2/2 attack me for 2 damage next turn (I go to 9), then swing with Bonebreaker Giant (4/4) for 4 damage. That's a net 2-life swing in my favor and keeps me on a faster kill.
